0.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_000
0.description: Welcome, friend of Oboro. What is it you would ask of me?

6.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_010
6.description: I am called Yomei. I hail from Doma, far, far across the seas to the east. And I am a shinobi, like my father before me.

7.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_011
7.description: My father lost his life in battle when the Garleans invaded our land, leaving me alone in this world. When Oboro told me of his mission, I asked to join him, that I, too, might have my revenge against the traitorous demon who betrayed us.

8.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_012
8.description: I am but a <hex:021A020203>genin<hex:021A020103>, the least experienced of our kind, and Oboro insists that I am still too young for battle. I believe I am ready, but I do not question his judgment. And so I assist in what ways I can while devoting myself to my training.

9.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_030
9.description: Oboro is a true shinobi─strong in body and mind. As a teacher, he is stern yet gentle. I look up to him as the elder brother I never had, as did many in my village.

10.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_031
10.description: He was the first to step forth and accept this mission. There were many of our kind─<hex:021A020203>jonin<hex:021A020103> with the strength and wisdom of years─who chose to stay home in the village rather than chase the traitor to this far-flung realm. Yet Oboro insists there was not a moment's hesitation in his heart.

11.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_032
11.description: The elders eyed him skeptically. Perhaps they felt his experience and ability did not measure up to his ambition. But I know different─and when Oboro returns home, his mission complete, the elders will know what I know.

12.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_020
12.description: My people are the descendants of an ancient clan that traces its origins back to an age of war and strife. My ancestors isolated themselves in a secluded village and devoted themselves to the martial arts, that they might defend themselves and their land from the chaos around them.

13.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_021
13.description: At first, my ancestors lived solitary lives. In time, however, their martial abilities came to be recognized by mighty warlords, who enlisted their services. So it was that my ancestors came to serve from the shadows, performing assassinations, espionage, and other such disagreeable-yet-indispensable duties.

14.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_022
14.description: In the early days, my ancestors were known by many names: the shadow, the grass, the silent ones, those who see but are not seen... In time, as our existence became widely known and accepted by the greater populace, the people came to call us by a single name: <hex:021A020203>shinobi<hex:021A020103>, the hidden.

15.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_023
15.description: Our art─the art of ninjutsu─has been honed through the centuries, passed down from master to student, master to student. The shinobi uses ritual hand gestures called <hex:021A020203>mudra<hex:021A020103> to channel the energies of the world around him─heaven, earth, and man─and unleash a host of lethal attacks.

16.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_024
16.description: There are many aspects of our art that we ourselves do not fully understand. For example, when a shinobi loses his concentration and misforms a mudra, it has been known to summon forth a curious rabbit-like creature from dimensions unknown.

17.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_025
17.description: Ah, I can see it even now─that toothy grin staring at me, mocking me! Oh, that I would never lay eyes on one of those foul creatures again!

18.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_090
18.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You honor us with your presence. How might Yomei serve you today?

19.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_030_099
19.description: Master Oboro is as sullen as I have ever seen him. Whatever troubles him so?

20.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_040_099
20.description: Please look after Master Oboro, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. It is not that I doubt his judgment, of course, but one never knows what tricks Karasu has up his sleeve...

25.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_100
25.description: We fare quite well. With no word from the village asking him to hasten his return, Master Oboro intends to remain here for the foreseeable future to continue his study of Eorzean culture. With the immediate danger having passed, he has even agreed to resume my lessons, which pleases me greatly.

26.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_101
26.description: Though he does not readily admit it, I suspect he has grown quite fond of this realm. I remember the days when he struggled to stomach any Eorzean fare, but the other day─why, I saw him enjoying a glass of aldgoat milk! When I expressed my admiration, he said that anything is possible if one's mind is focused to the task.

27.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_102
27.description: Master Oboro's feelings remain conflicted─finding out the truth about Master Gekkai surely affected him more than anyone─yet I, for one, have found peace in knowing that my father's death has been avenged. I once thought Master Oboro a brother, but today I am proud to call him Master.

28.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_010_100
28.description: Life has changed little since last we spoke. We await orders from our village, and serve as Master Oboro's eyes, ears, and blades in the meantime.

29.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_010_101
29.description: However, he has been in high spirits of late. Why, he drinks aldgoat milk every morning now─much to the surprise of the rest of us.

30.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_010_102
30.description: But enough of this─I have heard new paths are opening to you <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. It is pleasing to me, that one of another land pursue our arts with such vigor.

31.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_010_103
31.description: As one shinobi to another, I am glad of your progress. No doubt we have you to thank for Master Oboro's mood as well.

32.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_020_100
32.description: I have heard of Princess Yuki's departure. But there has been no missive from the village elders, congratulatory or otherwise, and I believe we have Tsubame to thank for that.

33.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_020_101
33.description: I suspect Master Oboro is secretly grateful for this further reprieve. He has grown very fond of this land, and would be loath to return to the village just now.

34.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_020_102
34.description: I wonder if the thought of leaving hangs heavy over his head, however. Of late, he is all sighs and distracted looks. It is even rumored he misformed a mudra, and called a─ Ah, but I have already said too much.

35.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_030_100
35.description: Master Oboro has departed for Kugane, but I have received no tidings from him yet. I do hope all is well...

36.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_030_101
36.description: Ever since he was told that he was not needed back at the village, I swear he has not stopped sighing for a second. This, despite it being his own idea to lie to the elders so he could remain here in the first place!

37.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_030_102
37.description: He is a good man, and a model to all shinobi, but sometimes I just want to slap some─ah, forgive me, friend. I am but a genin, and I forget myself.

38.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_040_100
38.description: You have met with Master Oboro in Kugane? I trust he is doing well.

39.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_040_101
39.description: Though his constant hand-wringing can get wearisome, I cannot begrudge the man his worries. After all, he has many matters weighing on his mind.

40.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_040_102
40.description: His duty to the village elders, his duty to his loyal followers here, and his duty to what he believes in─these are not always one and the same. We are most fortunate to have such a thoughtful leader.

41.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_050_100
41.description: Master Oboro has returned, and it is as if he has returned a new man. How can I put it? It would seem that he has found the courage of his convictions.

42.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_050_101
42.description: The sighs have ceased, and his every action is carried out with purpose. He says that he must live up to Master Sasuke's example, and I daresay he resembles our forefather─what I have heard of him, at least─more and more by the day.

43.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_050_102
43.description: What's more, every time he speaks of his pursuit of Karasu, I swear I can see the slightest hint of a sparkle in his sullen eyes─hm? Of course that is a compliment, friend. I would never speak ill of Master Oboro.

44.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_060_100
44.description: For better or for worse, everything is much as one would expect. Oboro is pursuing his rival, Karasu, with more zeal and dogged persistence than ever...and little in the way of actual success.

45.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_060_101
45.description: That said, who would have thought that the Oboro that returned to us from the Hermit's Hovel was actually Karasu in disguise? That crafty crow certainly had me fooled.

46.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_060_102
46.description: But looking back now that I know the truth, there was something...off about Oboro's behavior. How can I say it? He seemed strangely...personable? Amiable? Pleasant? Perhaps I should stop there...

47.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_070_100
47.description: When Master Oboro caught word that a great beast had emerged from the tower in Yanxia, he immediately began making preparations to go to his countrymen's aid.

48.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_070_101
48.description: Imagine our surprise when we contacted the Eastern alliance only to be told that the menace had already been quelled, and supposedly by my master's own hand.

49.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_070_102
49.description: It would appear that Karasu is up to his old tricks, disguising himself as my master and performing feats of derring-do in his name. The fact that witnesses to the battle said that the hero was laughing all the while would seem to corroborate this.

50.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_070_103
50.description: I was certain Master Oboro would choose to reveal the truth, but he steadfastly refused to blow Karasu's cover, so that he might continue to monitor him from afar. Taking credit for the deed was surely no more than an unintended side effect.

51.name: TEXT_JOBDEFNIN_00015_YOUMEI_000_110
51.description: Is this some kind of test, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Surely a skilled <hex:021A020203>jonin<hex:021A020103> such as yourself could answer that question better than I. Ah, but forgive me─it is not Yomei's place to question, but to answer.

52.description: My people are the descendants of an ancient clan that traces its origins back to an age of war and strife. My ancestors isolated themselves in a secluded village and devoted themselves to the martial arts, that they might defend themselves and their land from the chaos around them.
